confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or menus. Argentine prices in USD have moved sharply with peso volatility and multiple exchange rates (official, card, and informal), so restaurant and hotel anchors could be well off. Accommodation anchors assume July winter-holiday pricing and include taxes. The 2026-10-15 RBA USD/AUD observation came from search-result summaries of RBA pages; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Argentine tourist cities such as Córdoba and Salta, and against wine-tourism destinations in Latin America. Drink prices use Mendoza's wine-region relationship: wine is cheap relative to beer and cocktails.
